versions.changelog:
- Enforces that cover_letter.recipient must now contain only the contact or team (not the company), and company address fields must not repeat the company name.
- Updates cover letter generation and validation to strictly match the profile in external mode; prevents the use of the bundled fictional profile when an external one is expected.
- Documents and now requires the --profile-dir argument when generating cover letters with an external profile.
- Details best practices and restrictions for sending generated job application documents via chat, including attachment policies and explicit delivery authorizations.
- Removes the obsolete skill-card.md file.
V2 workflow, reproducible fictional examples, updated CV templates, and privacy-safe external data storage.
Add optional project organization and context metadata to distinguish employer work from projects created through the candidate own company, while preserving compatibility with existing profiles.
Initial privacy-safe release with cross-platform LaTeX rendering, fictional examples, update-safe external profile storage, and OpenSpec documentation.
